_doc: Landmarks added to Map v2 that have no v1 record: placed as given (world units, after the v1 sites, before the residential infill), by tools/geo/build_worlddata.cjs. Rows are N.WORLD_DATA.landmarks records. Both park gates are walk-through (noSolid) with solid piers: indira_park_gate spans the start of indira_park_path, and the Sanjeevaiah Park access spur runs past its gate. panjagutta_mall_site is the fenced construction site on the east corner of the Panjagutta junction where the mall and its multiplex opened in Nov 2004 (Hyderabad Central, 17.4264 N 78.4531 E; its PVR from 2005-06): in 2003 tin hoardings, a concrete frame and a tower crane (draw 'mall_site'); its corner lies off the curated roads, and the builder's no-infill ring drops the modern OSM service lanes that cross it.
